hero.title: Saudi-designed running shoes
hero.lead: Pick a color for each part of the JIANOVA shoe, from the laces to the outsole, and turn it in 3D as you go.
hero.alt: The JIANOVA running shoe from the side, deep purple with a white midsole and a dark outsole

parts.title: Seven parts of the shoe to color
parts.lead: The upper, tongue, laces, collar, heel, midsole and outsole each take their own color, so the details can match or stand apart.

items.title: Upper and tongue
items.text: The two largest surfaces. Color them alike, or set the tongue apart.
items.alt: The front of the shoe with a near-black upper and white laces

items.title: Laces
items.text: Dark laces on a light tongue, or one color from the toe to the collar.
items.alt: Laces and tongue from above: dark laces on a white tongue

items.title: Collar and heel
items.text: The padded ring round the ankle and the firm counter that holds your heel.
items.alt: The back of the shoe showing the purple heel and collar

items.title: Midsole and outsole
items.text: The foam layer and the rubber under it, each in a color of its own.
items.alt: The sole from the side: a white midsole over an orange outsole

steps.title: Design your shoe in three steps

items.title: Choose a part of the shoe
items.text: Select it in the list or tap it on the shoe. The part glows for a moment, so you can see which one you are changing.
items.alt: The shoe with its laces lit up, the part being changed

items.title: Color the shoe part you chose
items.text: The shoe changes as soon as you choose, with a short fade from the old color to the new one.
items.alt: The shoe with orange laces, collar and heel

items.title: Turn the shoe and look closer
items.text: Drag to turn the shoe, or use the buttons and the keyboard. Zoom in to see where two colors meet.
items.alt: The same shoe from behind, showing the orange heel

idea.title: Our first running shoe
idea.before: We are designing our first running shoe, and the tools that let every runner make a pair
idea.after: , starting with the designer on this site.

colors.title: Eight colors for every part of the shoe
colors.lead: Choose a color to see it on the upper. In the designer, any part can take any of the eight.
colors.alt: The JIANOVA shoe with a {color} upper

questions.title: Questions about JIANOVA
questions.lead: Short answers about the shoe, the designer and the store.

items.q: Can I buy a JIANOVA shoe now?
items.a: Not yet. The shoe is still in design and the store is not open. You can already design your pair here.

items.q: Is the shoe on this site the final design?
items.a: No. It is a simplified model, there so you can try the designer. The final shoe will replace it once its design is done.

items.q: Can I save my shoe design?
items.a: Not yet. The designer keeps your colors only while the page is open.

items.q: Does the shoe designer work on a phone?
items.a: Yes. Turn the shoe with one finger, pinch to zoom, and use the buttons to turn it a step at a time.

items.q: Can I design the shoe in Arabic?
items.a: Yes. Every page, the designer included, is in English and Arabic. Switch with the link at the top of the page.

hero.title: The JIANOVA logo and colors
hero.lead: The star is drawn from the A in the wordmark, the one without a crossbar: four of them, one for each point. Download the files and use them as this page shows.
hero.alt: The JIANOVA logo: a four-pointed star beside the wordmark

star.title: Four A's make the star
star.text: Each point has the angle of the wordmark's A, 38.6 degrees at the tip, and each side curves smoothly in to the next point. The points above and below are longer, so the star still reads as a star at 16 pixels.
star.diagramLabel: Diagram: the letter A of the wordmark, its 38.6 degree tip, and four copies of it turned to form the star

files.title: Logo files
files.lead: SVG files scale to any size. Use the white versions on purple or on photographs.

colors.title: Brand colors and type
colors.lead: Royal purple leads. The rest of the page stays neutral, so the purple and the shoe stand out.

rows.name: Royal purple
rows.use: The logo, buttons and the brand band

colors.typeText: Instrument Serif for headings and Instrument Sans for text. In Arabic, Noto Naskh Arabic and IBM Plex Sans Arabic.

use.title: Using the logo
use.lead: A few rules keep the logo clear at every size.

rows.name: Clear space
rows.text: Keep empty space at least as wide as the star on every side of the logo.

rows.name: Smallest size
rows.text: The star 16 px tall on its own; the full logo 120 px wide.

rows.name: Colors
rows.text: Royal purple on light grounds, white on purple or on photographs. No other colors.

rows.name: Keep it as drawn
rows.text: Never add a crossbar to the A, outline or turn the star, or change the space between the star and the name.
